== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster adds your own card to the exceptions for recurring Force loss reduction. Both retain the opponent’s control-phase timing, the 2-Force deployment reduction, the battleground-drain exception, the cumulative reduction and minimum 1.
